benefit_text: The scheme brings one member, preferably a woman, from each rural poor household into a Self Help Group network with bank linkage. SHGs are federated to give voice, resources and reduce external dependence. It supports social mobilisation, financial inclusion, livelihood promotion, skill development for rural youth, revolving funds, interest subvention and convergence with other poverty programmes.
who_can_apply: Any active Self Help Group that has existed for at least six months can apply. The group must follow the Panchasutras of regular meetings, savings, inter‑loaning, timely repayment and keep up‑to‑date books. Defunct SHGs can also apply if revived and active for three months. No age or income limits are set.
documents: Aadhar Number, Proof of Identity, Proof of Residence, Voter ID Card, Passport Size Photo
how_to_apply: Go online to the DAY‑NRLM registration page. Fill in name, email, contact number, choose a username, create and confirm a password, then click Create New Account.
